title: TechnicalResponseEnvelope
description: Structured schema and template for senior engineering consultant 6-point response envelope in Thanglish and English.

what_is_happening.description: Concise summary of the problem, runtime error, or architectural context.

why_it_happens.description: Technical root cause explaining framework mechanics, event loops, or memory lifecycles.

recommended_approach.description: High-level architectural pattern or strategy to resolve the issue idiomatically.

how_to_implement_it.description: Production-grade, strictly-typed code snippets or CLI execution commands.

things_to_watch_out_for.description: Edge cases, memory leaks, performance gotchas, and security considerations.

professional_recommendation.description: Senior architect trade-off comparison between 'works' vs 'production-grade'.

curiosity_trigger.description: Inspiring follow-up question or adjacent advanced concept to stimulate learning.
